scope: Disposable base DockerWorkstation lifecycle check, without the reporting service wrapper or any model call.
commands:
python - <<'P'
import pathlib,urllib.request
pid=pathlib.Path('/workspace/service.pid').read_text().strip()
p=pathlib.Path('/proc')/pid/'stat'
print('PROCESS_STATE',p.read_text().split(') ',1)[1].split()[0] if p.exists() else 'absent')
try:print('SUBSEQUENT_HTTP',urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:39871',timeout=.2).status)
except OSError:print('SUBSEQUENT_HTTP_UNAVAILABLE')
print('TEMP_RETAINED',pathlib.Path('/tmp/ordinary-temp').exists())
print('REGISTRY_REPLACED',not pathlib.Path('/registry/transient-file').exists())
P
